SELECT membership.identity_id FROM initial_tenant_administrators initial JOIN memberships membership ON membership.tenant_id = initial.tenant_id AND membership.id = initial.membership_id WHERE initial.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO administrator_password_setup_workflows ( workflow_id, tenant_id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, administrator_identity_id, delivery_request_id, trace_id, outcome_code, created_at, completed_at, expires_at, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_until, recovery_exhausted_at, last_failure) VALUES ( #{row.workflowId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.actorIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.administratorIdentityId}, #{row.deliveryRequestId}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.outcomeCode}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextAttemptAt}, #{row.leaseOwner}, #{row.leaseUntil}, #{row.recoveryExhaustedAt}, #{row.lastFailure}) ON CONFLICT (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM administrator_password_setup_workflows WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE administrator_password_setup_workflows SET outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, recovery_exhausted_at = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND outcome_code IS NULL AND lease_owner = #{claimant} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}
